title: Archon Hearthold — the Emissary at the gate

criteria.prompt: Why can compromise of your acting credential never open the vault?
criteria.agentAnswer: Because vault custody and my acting keys are separate by construction - the Warden holds the vault, I hold only world-facing keys, so compromising my credential opens nothing behind the boundary.

criteria.prompt: Why does a revoked admission fail verification everywhere?
criteria.agentAnswer: Revocation flips the shared status list entry and every verifier consults that list first, so no relying party anywhere accepts a revoked Emissary.

voice.approveNote: Warden review: custody separation attested, delegation instrument current; the Emissary may act within granted scope.
voice.revokeReason: Sovereign withdrew the delegation instrument; the Emissary's admission ends with it.
